item.title: Lightweight Serverless .NET Azure Function CI/CD
item.description: This project details the architecture and implementation of a lightweight, non-containerized CI/CD pipeline for a .NET 8 Azure Function targeting the new Flex Consumption plan, emphasizing zero-trust security and efficiency.

item.title: Lightweight Serverless Deployment with Azure Functions and Azure DevOps
item.description: This project details the architecture and implementation of a lightweight, non-containerized PaaS deployment for a .NET 8 Azure Function. It features a zero-trust CI/CD pipeline built with Azure DevOps, leveraging Azure’s Flex Consumption plan and Managed Identities for secure, efficient serverless operations.

item.title: Zero-Trust Serverless CI/CD with Azure Functions
item.description: Architected and implemented a lightweight, zero-trust CI/CD pipeline for a .NET 8 Azure Function on the Flex Consumption plan. This solution prioritizes speed and security by leveraging native Azure services and eliminating container overhead.
